subject.title: [Feature]: Show session and requester context in macOS exec approval popup

question: Which requester-origin fields may the macOS exec-approval popup display, and what redaction or truncation must be applied?
rationale: The payload can identify the originating turn, but exposing raw session, destination, account, thread, sender, or model-reasoning data is a user-visible privacy and security choice rather than a mechanical parity fix.

options.title: Sanitized Origin Summary
options.body: Show a compact sanitized session plus channel/account/thread context, while omitting tool reasoning and raw sender identifiers unless separately approved.

options.title: Sanitized Session Only
options.body: Show only a shortened session identity now and leave richer requester metadata for a separate policy decision.

options.title: Keep Current Metadata
options.body: Defer requester-origin display until a broader cross-surface disclosure policy is established.

recommendation.title: Sanitized Origin Summary
recommendation.body: Show a compact sanitized session plus channel/account/thread context, while omitting tool reasoning and raw sender identifiers unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review explicitly identified the unresolved native disclosure decision, making this the strongest available routing signal for the product and security boundary.
